scope: Ordered current projection and source lifecycle
Full BRB/WHAM configuration composition at finite targets

Independent reference (tests/electromagnetism/test_device_composition_evidence.py): the composition is decided exactly as a contraction. The device must stack the matrices its own children return, and the device field must equal current @ gpsi for those same arrays, decided in Fraction arithmetic over the returned binary64 values with a (n + 2) eps bound. A device that reordered its children, applied the currents along the target axis, or summed the wrong axis cannot satisfy both statements at once.

Implementation relation: children are registered in attribute-assignment order and iterated in that order; current is the per-child current vector, rzw is the per-child (R, Z, w) table list, and gpsi/gBR/gBZ stack one row per child. psi/BR/BZ contract the child matrices with the per-child currents, and a scalar current is broadcast to every child; a mesh can be supplied at the call or stored on the device, and deleting a child removes its row.

Test matrix (3 cases): the ordering, current vector, rzw list and stacked matrices of a two-child device, with the Fraction-decided contraction and an explicit current override; the mesh lifecycle including replacement, re-read by the children and an empty device; and the fixed-configuration contraction of WHAM. Boundary cases are the empty device and a scalar current; the failure matrix covers a wrong-length current vector and a missing mesh.

Composition budget, fixed before the comparison ran: (n + 2) eps of the accumulated sum for an n-child contraction, because each product is exact in the sense of the child response and the sum adds n roundings plus the final one. The matrix stacking and ordering assertions are exact equalities.

Failure matrix, one executable assertion per channel: ValueError for a current vector whose length differs from the child count or holds a nonfinite entry, and for a field request with no mesh; TypeError for an unrecognised constructor keyword.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Independent exact geometry laws, the elementary on-axis loop field, and exact composition contractions for the named objects. Not experimental qualification and not an arbitrary-domain bound.
known_limitations: No experimental validation of source device constants, conductor area proxy or material magnetization is claimed.
Direct geometry/weight arrays can be mutated; cache content changes are detected, but mutation that desynchronizes parameterized geometry from its parameters is outside the supported contract.
Unrecognised **kwargs are permissive where inherited; no arbitrary keyword semantic claim.
Plotting/patch, simplify/clone, multiprocessing, electrodes and persistent sweeps are excluded or unresolved.
No scientific, experimental or licensing approval is claimed.
The evidence covers the declared parameters and the fixed configurations only; the field statements are made on named targets and are not an arbitrary-domain bound.

basis.statement: Independent exact geometry laws, the elementary on-axis loop field and exact composition contractions decide the named objects; this is not experimental qualification and not an arbitrary-domain bound.

summary: Compose ordered circular-filament sources and contract their per-child Green responses with scalar or per-child currents.

capability: Compose ordered circular-filament sources and contract their Green responses with scalar or per-child currents.
operation: registered child sources and currents -> summed fields
discovery.model: Linear superposition of axisymmetric ideal circular-filament responses.
discovery.geometry: Ordered child source geometries on a shared target mesh.
discovery.boundary: A field call needs a mesh and a current vector compatible with the registered children.

identity.direction: registered child sources and currents to summed fields
identity.definition: Device stores CurrentFilamentSet children in assignment order and contracts their Green matrices.
identity.model: Linear superposition of axisymmetric ideal circular-filament responses.
identity.geometry: Ordered child source geometries on a shared target mesh.
identity.coordinates: Cylindrical R,Z in metres; currents in amperes; responses in Wb/rad and tesla.
identity.boundary: A field call needs a mesh and a current vector compatible with the registered children.
assumptions: Only CurrentFilamentSet attributes become registered children.
Scalar current overrides apply to every child; vectors follow child order.
Child geometry and weight arrays remain mutable.

inputs.name: mesh
inputs.description: Optional target mesh; extra keyword attributes that are CurrentFilamentSet instances register ordered children.
inputs.constraints: Mesh accepted by conversion; non-source keyword attributes are ordinary attributes.

outputs.name: source
outputs.description: Constructed Device object. Available properties/methods: psi: Summed flux [Wb/rad], (Nt,); BR: Summed radial field [T], (Nt,); BZ: Summed axial field [T], (Nt,) Ordered iteration/current/rzw properties and gpsi/gBR/gBZ per-child matrices; psi/BR/BZ methods accept current=None and mesh=None. Returns a scirel object positionally: the caller receives the instance itself, not as a field of a returned mapping.
outputs.constraints: Field methods require a configured or supplied target mesh; geometry and lifecycle properties are those of the constructed object.

preconditions: Only CurrentFilamentSet attributes become registered children.
Scalar current overrides apply to every child; vectors follow child order.
supported: Child registration/replacement/deletion, mesh propagation, per-child current contraction, and empty-device shapes.
excluded: Plotting, persistent sweeps, and unsupported source operations.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError is raised for invalid meshes, current overrides, missing meshes, or child kernel singularities; duplicate child registration raises AttributeError.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; composition is a direct matrix contraction.
failure_semantics.partial_results: Failed child assignment leaves the existing registered set unchanged; a failed field call returns no field vector.

example.description: Register one ArbitraryPoints child on a one-point mesh and evaluate the composed device.
example.code:
from scirel.electromagnetism import Device,ArbitraryPoints
d=Device(mesh=[[.2,.3]])
d.a=ArbitraryPoints([[1.,0.]])
assert d.psi().shape == (1,)
example.expected: The ordered device returns a finite psi vector with shape (1,).
